title: stable-predication-cell
description: The stable corner of the predication cell's four-point slot-presence partition - the dual single-committed corner. A refinement of the predication cell reached by the predication category's internal morphisms, sharing its four-point form with the articulation cell and the bilattice charge.

slot-presence.description: this corner of the recurring slot-presence partition; the dual single-committed corner

stable.description: one side is committed in the dual sense - the cell is stable
